env.ours: x3d.threejs reader (shared with the Babylon bridge) + three.js body, bundle sha fa1672fe84a6

scope: a sound loaded from url is decoded by the browser at the audio context's own rate (44100 Hz in the test rig), so sampleRate and bufferLength read back the resampled values (a 1600 sample 8 kHz file reads 44100 and 8820), identical in both engines; the file formats and the network loading of other schemes than data: are not compared

the field is bufferLength in X_ITE 16.6.0 and bufferlength (lowercase l, output only) in the X3D 4.0 XSD and UOM; both names exist here and the test uses the X_ITE one at run time, because the XSD one cannot be written; a pause stops the source and resume starts it again at the paused position, since a Web Audio buffer source cannot pause; autoRefresh and autoRefreshTimeLimit are held, not acted on; loopStart and loopEnd are set on the source but the looped part is not measured; a url that is not a data: or same-origin file is not fetched in the test; X_ITE 16.6.0 reports bufferDuration -1 (not the UOM's 0) from the start while load is TRUE and nothing has loaded; the bridge does the same
